title: Aerosol Can Adapters for the 74000 & 75000 Fuel Injection Machines
lead: MOC has developed 2 new adapters (Part #s 72416 & 75021) for the 74000 & 75000 Fuel Injection Machines to connect to the aerosol cans.
body: The 72409 adapter is discontinued and replaced by the 72416 adapter. The 74500 adapter is discontinued and replaced by the 75021 adapter.
